title: Ginger (Green): modeled ₹914/qtl left, Shimla → Kangra (Baijnath)
summary: January 2023: reported ginger (Green) prices at Shimla and Kangra (Baijnath) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 89% of 18 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹914 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 420 same-variety market pairs screened for ginger (Green) in January 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Green Ginger, FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kangra (Baijnath) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2023
scenes.caption: Shimla (Himachal Pradesh) and Kangra (Baijnath) (Himachal Pradesh) both reported ginger (Green) prices for the same variety and grade (Green Ginger, FAQ) on 18 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Shimla reported a median ₹5,500 per quintal. Kangra (Baijnath) reported a median ₹7,250 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,725/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,725 per quintal, and Kangra (Baijnath) was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 295 km by road
scenes.caption: 295 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~4 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹63/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹946 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹553 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kangra (Baijnath) report, the rule selects 18 of 18 modeled shipping days. 16 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹914 per quintal (₹536 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Ginger (Green) route from Shimla to Kangra (Baijnath) was positive on 89% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹91,400, or ₹53,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

title: Ginger (Green): modeled ₹2,663/qtl left, Kattappana → Punalur
summary: December 2023: reported ginger (Green) prices at Kattappana and Punalur imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 89% of 19 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹2,663 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 462 same-variety market pairs screened for ginger (Green) in December 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Punalur report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: December 2023
scenes.caption: Kattappana (Kerala) and Punalur (Kerala) both reported ginger (Green) prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 19 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kattappana reported a median ₹11,000 per quintal. Punalur reported a median ₹14,800 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹4,200/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹4,200 per quintal, and Punalur was dearer on 95% of days.

scenes.headline: 154 km by road
scenes.caption: 154 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹33/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹2,920 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹2,197 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
